header.title: Export to After Effects
header.subtitle: Rebuilds a timeline as a faithful After Effects comp (positions, tracks, frame-accurate) with a generated script.

result.imported: Imported into After Effects (check the Project panel).
result.launching: After Effects is starting — it'll import on launch (needs an open project).
result.missing: Shots skipped because the file was missing: {{count}}.

form.bakeForcesReencode: Speed baked in: shots are re-encoded whatever the mode above.
form.nestedHintComp: The nested timeline becomes its own precomp (audio inside it).
form.nestedHintRender: Resolve renders the nested timeline to a single file (faithful, slow), imported as 1 layer.
form.nestedHintFlatten: Shots from the nested timeline are flattened straight into the comp. They follow the Video mode above.
form.precompEach: Each video shot in a precomp
form.foldersLabel: Sort into folders (Footage / Precomps / Audio / Images)
form.upscaleForcesReencode: Upscaling replaces pixels: Re-encode applies whatever is picked above.

copy.label: Copy
copy.hint: Source files, cut in AE — no transcode.

remux.label: Remux
remux.hint: Lossless .mov container (-c copy), cut in AE.

reencode.label: Re-encode
reencode.hint: Each shot transcoded to an edit codec, cut frame-accurately, handles included.

none.label: None
none.hint: Raw footage — ignores timeline transforms and speed.

ae.label: In After Effects
ae.hint: Transforms + speed on the AE layer, source untouched.

bake.label: Re-encoded
bake.hint: Speed and framing baked into the file, with the codec chosen above, at timeline size. Outside the frame: black, unless that codec carries an alpha channel. An ANIMATED framing is rendered by DaVinci Resolve, keyframes included: faithful, but one render per shot.
